lines.say: ChatGPT can do your problem sheet. It can't come into the exam with you.
So which actually helps? A, reading the worked solution. B, explaining the method to a blank page.
B. Reading it feels like learning. Explaining it is learning. That's the testing effect.
The app gives you the prompt. You explain it in your own words.
Try it now. Explain the chain rule out loud. Go.
